mechanism_narrative: A negative 3-month change in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates monetary easing, compressing discount rates and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS 3-month change is negative, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year increase in CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 2.5% signals persistent inflation, triggering monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL YOY change > 2.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When 3-month non-farm payrolls growth (PAYEMS) exceeds 0.5% and unemployment rate (UNRATE) declines by more than 0.2 percentage points, it signals a tightening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth > 0.5% and UNRATE decline > 0.2pp in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances where PAYEMS growth > 0.5% and UNRATE decline > 0.2pp, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime (FEDFUNDS > 1.5%), the S&P 500 tends to underperform, producing negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in < 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 1.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1000 thousand units signals weak consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances where HOUST < 1000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105 (2017=100) signals an economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances where INDPRO < 105, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) grow by more than 0.5% and housing starts (HOUST) grow by more than 0.3% over the past 3 months, it signals robust consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS growth > 0.5% and HOUST growth > 0.3% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances where RSAFS growth > 0.5% and HOUST growth > 0.3%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.5% signals a tightening labor market, associated with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to improved consumer confidence.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in < 40% of instances where UNRATE < 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
